title: Drawing, layout and touch
changes: Hold the pen still in Beautify mode to snap a sketch into a clean shape. Select several items to align them, space them evenly or tidy up their layout.
Pasted images appear while they upload. Select an image to change its corners from square to fully rounded.
On a phone, use one finger to draw and two to pan or zoom. The compact toolbar keeps all drawing tools within reach.
Invite previews show the board name. Voice chat shows how many people are in a call before you join.

title: Text, saved views and collaboration
changes: Apply bold or underline to individual words, preview fonts by hovering, and resize selected text with + and −.
Save a board area as a named view. Open Views with gv, or choose Follow to see where a collaborator is working.
Adjust the pen and eraser in one-pixel steps. Erase just the ink under the brush or switch to whole strokes.
